checkpoint_berlin.name: checkpoint_berlin
checkpoint_berlin.value: "balance_checkpoints"."observed_at" IS NULL OR ("balance_checkpoints"."observed_at" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = "balance_checkpoints"."observed_date"

closing_version.name: closing_version
closing_version.value: "month_closings"."version">0 AND (("month_closings"."version"=1) = ("month_closings"."previous_version_id" IS NULL)) AND length(trim("month_closings"."reason"))>0 AND "month_closings"."evidence_recorded_cutoff_seq"<"month_closings"."recorded_seq" AND "month_closings"."snapshot_schema_version">0 AND "month_closings"."selection_contract_version">0

closing_free.name: closing_free
closing_free.value: "month_closings"."historical_reserved_cents">=0 AND "month_closings"."historical_savings_cents">=0 AND ("month_closings"."historical_allocated_cents" IS NULL OR ("month_closings"."historical_allocated_cents">=0 AND "month_closings"."historical_free_cents"="month_closings"."historical_allocated_cents"-"month_closings"."historical_reserved_cents"-"month_closings"."historical_savings_cents"))

obligation_state.name: obligation_state
obligation_state.value: "obligation_events"."original_cents">0 AND "obligation_events"."outstanding_cents">=0 AND "obligation_events"."status" IN ('UNPAID','PAID','CANCELLED') AND ("obligation_events"."status"<>'UNPAID' OR ("obligation_events"."outstanding_cents">0 AND ("obligation_events"."is_possible" OR "obligation_events"."reserve_full"))) AND ("obligation_events"."status"='UNPAID' OR NOT "obligation_events"."reserve_full") AND ("obligation_events"."status"<>'PAID' OR "obligation_events"."outstanding_cents"=0)
